label: corrected_round2
semantics: Same checkpoint minimizes successor network value over all legal still-pending and newly generated delays independently for each chosen action; elapsed physical events are frozen. Greedy additionally maximizes those minima over actions. Comparator selects its action from received observation only.
limitations: Not a terminal-payoff minimax optimum or convergence certificate.
Different checkpoints define different learned adversaries, so cross-checkpoint returns change both controller and adversary.
Comparator outcome is feasible against this checkpoint-defined adversary; it is not a guaranteed lower bound against every legal adversary.
Same deterministic market tape, fixed warmup and no additional random trials.
